policies.source_facts: ordinary item/relative-weight pools, Lv7 special families 40001/50001 with 70/30 relative weights, rate_suit/rate_step/max_num rows
policies.proposal: Reuse V1 fixed-point Scholarship ladder: attempt=misses+1; forge 10bp and reforge 100bp per eligible attempt; cap/hard ceiling at 1000/100. Reset lane misses on special hit; separate forge/reforge counters. Reforge excludes original template. A batch is 10 sequential draws with counters advanced/reset per draw.
policies.limitation: Outer probability/counter interpretation and same-result exclusion are reconstruction choices, not recovered official server math.

policies.proposal: Latest accepted paid rebuild replaces prior pending; original is not consumed/reserved until Save. Persist candidates, source, generation, content/policy, operation identity and entropy provenance across restart. Save accepts a member of latest frozen candidates, consumes one original and grants one selected template without RNG. Missing original causes durable stale-clear and rejected Save. Abandon discards without refund; no-pending Abandon is no-op. No wall-time expiry.
policies.limitation: Wire lacks occurrence/proposal nonce. Late identical Save/Abandon can address a newer pending occurrence; internal generation does not recover unavailable client intent.

policies.proposal: New eligible owner installation creates empty applied slots/no pending/zero misses and zero new certificate balances only under an explicit preservation seed version. Missing-only owner backfill preserves existing qualified rows. Existing/imported nonempty slots, pending/counters/balances need a typed provenance-bearing importer and per-row validation; reject/quarantine unqualified inputs rather than invent them.
policies.limitation: Client empty-array/zero fallback is not original-server initial/backfill truth; migration creates no eligible Hero.

policies.proposal: Applied live-Hero bindings block destructive retirement until explicitly removed; removal remains recovery-capable despite eligibility loss when canonical applied reference is valid. No automatic detach, refund or eventual cleanup. Pending inventory rebuild is not a Hero reference.
policies.limitation: D04 permits a qualified reject-or-atomic-detach choice; rejection is this bounded design proposal and requires adoption.

policies.proposal: Per-Hero Insert requires owner-qualified live Normal/Super stage COMPLETE=3 and level>=100. Forge/Rebuild require a genuine eligible owned Hero through a coherent upstream snapshot; Save/Abandon/Remove retain recovery paths for already-paid/applied state. Function45 announcement never authorizes gameplay; use existing I5 function mechanism when an actual qualification producer supplies its facts.
policies.limitation: Source establishes UI per-Hero gate; the global forge/rebuild admission and recovery exceptions are source-shaped V1 policy choices.

authorization_basis: Direct user adopted all proposals and authorized implementation/testing/reconciliation/closure, preserving named qualification gates
